cost.scope: OSMO task start-to-end wall time multiplied by one requested L40S per worker, including runtime setup, preflight, computation and archive upload. Queue and initialization before task start are excluded. This is a reservation proxy, not sampled GPU utilization or billed GPU time.
cost.token_scope: Experiment-time Astra API requests only. Coding, analysis and review agent token usage is not instrumented by this experiment.

claims: Novelty is relative to the supplied original and paper OOD task definitions, plus the already-used teacher tasks contained in that paper set.
Full checkpoint training coverage is unknown; these are candidate OOD compositions, not certified unseen pretraining data.
These definitions are separate from the paper benchmark and are never pooled into its reported success rate.
Simulator validation and policy solvability are separate checks. Task generation alone is not performance evidence.

flow_head.description: A bounded residual changes the policy’s action vector field during each Euler step. Original camera inputs and language conditioning are preserved.
flow_head.name: Learned flow-velocity head
flow_head.reading: The head is always enabled. Training flow-matching loss decreased, but the paired rollout counts show that lower training loss did not establish better control.
flow_head.training: 1,000 offline updates from actually executed teacher prefixes, with zero-residual native anchors. The base stays frozen. Unexecuted suffixes are imputed context, never demonstrated labels.

gated_flow_head.description: The same learned selector enables the same learned flow head. Only the gate is used: this arm applies no TEI/TLI edit and keeps original conditioning.
gated_flow_head.kind: USE THE GATE TO LIMIT ACTION CORRECTIONS
gated_flow_head.name: Selector-gated flow head
gated_flow_head.reading: Tests whether limiting correction exposure reduces harm. Its gate is inherited from text-intervention labels; it was not trained on paired evidence of whether this action head helps.
gated_flow_head.training: No separate refit. Load the identical selector and head used in the other two arms. With the gate off, the vector field is exactly native under the matched noise.

learned_selector.description: A small selector reads frozen native visual and instruction features plus robot state. It chooses native or a TEI/TLI operator, source pair and interpolation strength.
learned_selector.kind: LEARN WHEN AND HOW TO EDIT TEXT
learned_selector.name: Learned TEI/TLI selector
learned_selector.reading: The gate imitates teacher intervention support. A score above 0.5 enables an edit; it is not a calibrated failure probability or a prediction that editing will help.
learned_selector.training: 1,000 offline updates on successful teacher choices and native anchors. No explicit clock, task ID or future outcome. Choices persist between refreshes; the original instruction can identify a familiar task.

native.description: The original policy turns the current images, robot state and task instruction into fresh actions at every replan.
native.name: Frozen native π0.5
native.reading: The paired reference for every method. A successful reset here can still become a failure under an intervention; those losses are counted explicitly.
native.training: No additional learning. The pinned base checkpoint and its original normalization are used throughout.

recorded_schedule.description: Look up a successful Astra teacher’s TEI/TLI choice by task instruction and executed-action count. π0.5 still generates new actions from live observations.
recorded_schedule.name: Recorded teacher schedule
recorded_schedule.reading: Measures reuse of a task-specific teacher program on new resets. Its language schedule does not adapt to visual progress, even though the underlying policy remains closed-loop.
recorded_schedule.training: One teacher is chosen by a frozen priority for each of eight covered tasks. Replay operator, source pair and α; hold the last choice after the teacher ends. Uncovered tasks use native.
